name: Release v2026.10.0
body:
## 🤖 AI-Generated Changelog

## Added
- Support `file://` URLs as package index and mirror sources
- Support non-Git local VCS schemes in URL unpacking
- Accept newer minor `pylock.toml` lock versions with a warning instead of failing

## Fixed
- Correctly check `pylock.toml` `requires-python` and `environments` fields before installing
- Pick the correct matching entry for packages listed more than once in `pylock.toml`
- Preserve local, VCS, and file sources when generating `pylock.toml`
- Convert `file://` requirements.txt URLs to paths before resolving
- Fix malformed pip line for file URL extras on `--skip-lock` path
- Fix `file://` Pipfile entries being mis-handled as filesystem paths on Windows
- Fix VCS Pipfile entries collapsing when the name also resolves via the index
- Fix broken pip line when building `file=...+extras=[...]` dependencies
- Preserve existing Pipfile sources during requirements import
- Preserve requirements-file source order during deduplication
- Make requirements.txt `-i <url>` replace the default index rather than add to it
- Skip `--trusted-host` for hostless source URLs regardless of `verify_ssl`
- Fix insecure `verify_ssl=false` handling on hardcoded `file://` source blocks
- Recalculate lock hash after writing temporary Pipfile source

## Changed
- Vendor bumps: `packaging` to 26.3, `plette` to 2.4.0, `build` to 1.6.1, `pyproject_hooks` to 1.3.3, `dotenv` to 1.2.4
- Vendor `tomli` for hatchling's build isolation on Python < 3.11
- Consolidate `VCS_SCHEMES` into `pipenv.utils.constants`
- Migrate integration tests off real network dependencies to offline `file://`-based fixtures

---

🔗 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pypa/pipenv/compare/v2026.9.1...v2026.10.0
